_help: Enemy sprites. mem/monster.mem is GENERATED from this file + the PNG strips.  Rebuild: python scripts/build_monster_mem.py

monster.mem has 4 frames of 32x32: A0 A1 = monster A (the chaser), B0 B1 = monster B (the turret). scale 1 = as drawn, scale 2 = the 16x16 pixels around the art are doubled (same size as the hero; art must be at most 16x16).
Each sheet is a strip (or grid) of 32x32 cells. frame = {"sheet": name, "col": n, "row": 1}  (col from 0, row from 1).
Anything not listed, skipped, outside the sheet or fully transparent falls back to mem/monster_v1.mem (old art).
